title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. However, with busy schedules, many pregnant women often struggle to prepare healthy and delicious meals. In this article, we will introduce 5 cook-once recipes that can help pregnant women have nutritious and delicious dinners.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are selected based on the principle of balanced nutrition, including protein, fiber, and calcium. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), pregnant women need to consume about 70-100g of protein per day, along with 25-30g of fiber and 1,000mg of calcium.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken and Potato Soup
Chicken and potato soup is a delicious and easy-to-make dish that provides about 30g of protein, 4g of fiber, and 200mg of calcium.
- 1 chicken (about 1kg)
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar

### 2. Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry
Beef and vegetable stir-fry is a great option for dinner, providing about 35g of protein, 5g of fiber, and 150mg of calcium.
- 200g beef
- 1 bunch of vegetables (broccoli, carrots, bell peppers)
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar

### 3. Fried Eggs with Salad
Fried eggs with salad is a light and delicious option, providing about 20g of protein, 3g of fiber, and 100mg of calcium.
- 2 eggs
- 1 bunch of lettuce
- 1 tomato
- 1 onion
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar

### 4. Yogurt Parfait with Fruit
Yogurt parfait with fruit is a healthy and delicious dessert, providing about 15g of protein, 2g of fiber, and 200mg of calcium.
- 1 cup of yogurt
- 1 bunch of fruit (banana, apple, orange)
- 1 teaspoon of honey

### 5. Chicken and Coconut Rice
Chicken and coconut rice is a traditional and nutritious dish, providing about 30g of protein, 4g of fiber, and 150mg of calcium.
- 1 chicken (about 1kg)
- 2 cups of coconut milk
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar

## Practical Tips
- Choose fresh and nutritious ingredients and ensure food safety.
- Don't forget to drink plenty of water and limit sugary drinks.
- Check out our [meal planner](/planner) for daily meal ideas.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about your diet or health, consult your doctor or a nutritionist.

faqs.answer: A balanced diet ensures the health and well-being of both mother and baby, and supports the development of the fetus.
